perceptual_screening.insight: Screening was performed, unlike the older 18 October exact-only audit. Candidate matches are not confirmed duplicates; manual review remains incomplete and split was not changed.

tokenizer_audit.insight: IndoBERTweet Caption+OCR+Topic has maximum 210 and p95 83 tokens on official train, so no train input exceeds 256. XLM-R full-combination max is 257, one of 4018 inputs exceeds 256. These observations do not establish held-out test lengths.
